name: Precision Food Equipment LLC.
old_description: Specializing in slicer repair, Precision Food Equipment has been servicing satisfied return customers like Arby's, Wildflower Bread Company, Claim Jumper, YC's Mongolian Grill and many more all across Arizona for years.  We are always focused on customer service satisfaction and offer a satisfaction guarantee.  We only offer services that meet the highest industry standards and our staff is fully trained and qualified.  As you may have noticed, appliances aren’t as dependable as they were in the days of our parents and grandparents but you can be sure that we can fix your appliance right the first time and get it to operate like new again!
about:
Precision Food Equipment LLC operates from Gilbert, Arizona, where it was founded on April 5, 2008, by Jason Hertel. The company is family-owned and operated, born from Hertel’s observation that many restaurants and delis were overpaying for subpar repair work. He set out to provide honest, high-quality service at reasonable rates, guided by the principle that the company succeeds only when its customers succeed.

The business specializes in repair and preventive maintenance for a wide range of commercial food-preparation and cooking equipment. Technicians service all makes and models of meat slicers, vegetable cutters, mixers, meat choppers, grinders, bread and bagel slicers, vegetable choppers, warmers, and Amana commercial microwaves. They also serve as the Arizona authorized service location for several equipment brands and are the designated home of the EZPRO 120 ventless deep fryer for restaurants and concessions. Work is performed both on-site via mobile service and in the company’s shop, with after-hours and weekend availability.

Precision Food Equipment serves the foodservice industry across Arizona and, through the EZPRO line, nationally. Its customer base includes multi-unit chains such as Arby’s, Wildflower Bread Company, Claim Jumper, and YC’s Mongolian Grill, along with numerous independent restaurants, delis, and concession operators. Customized preventive-maintenance plans address safety, staff training, food-waste reduction, production consistency, and downtime prevention.

The company differentiates itself by routing every service call directly to a factory-trained technician, promising same-day or next-day response, and backing all work with a satisfaction guarantee. Hertel’s original commitment to transparent pricing and honest diagnostics remains the operational standard.

about:
Precision Metals Inc operates a full-service metal fabrication shop in Benson, North Carolina, serving contractors across eastern North Carolina including Wake, Johnston, and Harnett counties. The company is owned by Steve, who is noted in customer reviews for his hands-on involvement and customer service.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication for roofing and general contracting projects. Using a plasma cutting table, the team processes aluminum, steel, and copper, while Schechtl handbrakes handle folding and forming of single or small pieces. Outputs include metal roofing panels, gutters, coping, edge metal, chimney caps, and related accessories for both commercial and residential buildings.

Primary customers are roofing companies and general contractors who need customized metal components that standard suppliers cannot provide. Projects range from commercial metal trim packages and steep-slope metal roofing to residential roof replacements, such as a condo association project at Topsail Beach where .032 standing seam metal was installed over additional insulation.

Precision Metals was founded on the premise that many metal shops cannot tailor pieces to exact specifications. The company differentiates itself by offering free estimates, quick turnaround on custom orders, and pricing described as fair, aiming to keep contractors' projects on schedule.

name: Precision Metalworks LLC
old_description: Founded with a passion for turning ideas into reality, Precision Metalworks began as a part-time endeavor in 2019, driven by a love for craftsmanship and the art of creating unique welding projects. What started as a small-scale venture has since evolved into the creation of remarkable structural masterpieces, proudly serving some of the most renowned food processing plants.
about:
Precision Metalworks LLC operates from a shop on Dunbar Street in Fremont, Nebraska. The business was founded in 2019 as a part-time welding venture by a single craftsman working after hours, building a reputation one job at a time. What began with one machine and mobile repairs has grown into a full-time fabrication and welding operation serving eastern Nebraska.

The company provides three core services: mobile welding that brings equipment to farms and plants, repair welding for cracked or worn components, and custom fabrication from prints or rough sketches. In-house capabilities include a MultiCam 3000 waterjet with KMT pump, an Amada shear, an Amada press brake, Syncrowave AC/DC TIG welders, and MIG welding for production steel work. The shop works in stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel ranging from 22-gauge sheet to structural plate, handling everything from sanitary food-grade vessels to heavy equipment buckets and trailer frames.

Customers span food processing plants that require sanitary stainless welds, agricultural operations needing field repairs on combines and tillage tools, trailer owners with hitch and gooseneck damage, and industrial shops requiring brackets, racks, guards, and one-off structural parts. The mobile unit travels daily across eastern Nebraska, covering communities from Omaha to Schuyler.

The founder's intent was to keep work in-house rather than subcontract cutting and forming, shortening lead times and keeping a single point of accountability. The same tolerances demanded by food plants are applied to every trailer hitch and bracket, delivered at small-shop pricing with direct phone access.

Mobile welding service across eastern Nebraska
Same-day quotes for most inquiries
Sanitary stainless welding to food-plant standards
Single point of accountability from quote to delivery

about:
Precision Technologies, Inc., operating as Precision PCB, is headquartered in Elgin, Illinois.

The company offers a full suite of PCB services including design, fabrication, and assembly. Its fabrication capabilities cover single-sided, double-sided, and multilayer boards up to rigid-flex and HDI constructions, as well as RF/microwave and semiconductor PCBs. Assembly services include surface-mount placement down to 0201 passives, through-hole, mixed-technology, and leadless packages such as BGA, QFN, and LGA, all inspected to IPC-A-610 Class III. Production spans prototype through medium-volume runs, leveraging both domestic and offshore facilities.

Precision PCB serves customers in defense and aerospace, medical devices, automotive, LED lighting, industrial equipment, test and measurement, transportation, and networking and AI infrastructure. Its client base ranges from engineering teams needing quick-turn prototypes to buyers managing scheduled production deliveries.

The company emphasizes a "One-Stop Solution" model with a single point of contact from sales through delivery, aiming to eliminate communication gaps and engineering delays. It holds ITAR registration (CAGE 7T6D9) and ISO 9001:2015 certification, and advertises quick-turn capabilities such as next-morning delivery for double-sided boards ordered by 9 a.m. EST, 48-hour multilayer turns, and 24- to 48-hour prototype assembly.

Precision Steel works primarily with general contractors and builders on commercial, institutional, and government projects. Past project types include government buildings, strip malls and retail centers, service stations, churches, and schools across the tri-state area.

about:
Hospital Supply & O2 Solutions operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, as a division of Hospital Supply focused on respiratory care and durable medical equipment. The company serves patients and hospitals across the state, providing equipment and clinical support for sleep apnea and oxygen therapy.

The business supplies a range of positive airway pressure devices — including CPAP, VPAP, and APAP units — along with nasal, pillow, and full-face masks. For home oxygen therapy, it offers portable oxygen concentrators, stationary concentrators, oxygen cylinders, and nebulizers. A respiratory therapist meets with each referred patient to review the sleep study, demonstrate equipment use, explain insurance benefits, and handle billing.

Customers are primarily individuals referred by sleep physicians after a sleep study, as well as hospitals throughout New Mexico that require respiratory equipment and compliance support. The company coordinates directly with prescribing doctors and insurance carriers to qualify patients and deliver the prescribed devices.

The organization states its mission is to set standards of excellence in respiratory care, emphasizing responsive customer service and education for both staff and patients to achieve 100 percent compliance and satisfaction.
